title: DSH graph-loop bench result row
description: One row per (arm, task, repetition). Emitted by scripts/analyze-session.mjs for logged sessions and by scripts/run-arm.mjs for live runs. Arms: baseline (stock loop + standard preset), explore (stock loop + explore preset), graph-control (graph as control plane, one session), graph-node (graph nodes as subagent sessions).

runId.description: Stable id of this row, e.g. <task>.<arm>.r<repetition>.

sessionCount.description: Sessions this row aggregates. Subagent-node mode counts parent plus every node; a main-session row is always 1.

tools.description: Distinct tool schemas visible in the request.

toolSchemaBytes.description: Exact JSON.stringify length of the request's tools array.

promptTokens.description: Provider prompt tokens summed over steps (cache hit + miss + write). Heuristic when tokenSource=heuristic.

missTokens.description: Provider inputTokens = uncached input. This is the expensive bucket.

cacheReadRatio.description: cacheReadTokens / promptTokens. Kill-criterion metric: a per-node tool change breaks it.

billedInputUnits.description: missTokens + 0.02 * cacheReadTokens. One unit = one cache-miss token at list price, so arms are comparable across token sources.

billedOutputUnits.description: 4 * outputTokens at DeepSeek flash off-peak list prices.

billedCostUsd.description: billedInputUnits * $0.15/M + output at $0.60/M. Reprice with scripts/cost-model.mjs if prices change.

wallTimeMs.description: turn/start of the first turn to turn/end of the last.

tokenSource.description: provider = real usage from the API; heuristic = DSH token-meter price over the logged surface (mock/replay runs).

success.description: Task-specific check from tasks.jsonl; null when not evaluated.

breakdown.description: Mirrors DSH's contextBreakdown projection (systemTokens/toolsTokens/messageTokens) plus the provider's buckets.
